Palmetto Rage Volleyball
(Tentative) 12U 2027 Tournament Schedule

Tournament Names Dates | Location

Rumble at the Rock Jan 30th Rock Hill Sports Center, Rock Hill, SC

Crosstown Throwdown | Feb 14th TBA, Columbia, SC

Cl Challenge March 14th TBA, Easley, Greenville, Laurens, SC

Palmetto Regionals March 26" — 27th | Rock Hill Sports Center, Rock Hill, SC
Club fees: This year, club fees: 11U and 12U - $1,030
Very important: Players accepting a position on a team will be required to pay a $250 deposit, which
will be applied to the above fees. This deposit is non-refundable if the player decides not to play for
Palmetto Rage later.
The PRV fee includes Practices, Coaches’ salaries, and Expenses for Practices, including Gym rental, All
Tournaments, Equipment (Volleyballs, Courts, Nets, Practice Equipment, etc.), Overhead
(Administration, Websites, Bookkeeping, Staff, Hotel rooms for coaching staff).
Additional costs include Player Package approx. $133.00 (1 Jersey, 1 Spandex, Practice Tee, and
Backpack)You will get a link to order this package., JVA Fees, AAU Fees (if we are required to be
members to play), Individual Player's Travel Expenses, Possible Extra Tournaments, and Other Optional
Team Expenses.
Payment schedule: (once your child makes a team) You may pay your child’s club fee in full, or we will
offer a payment schedule of 4 installments.
